Marco G.: quick q — had to pay to upgrade to an aisle seat on my flight home yesterday because I hurt my ankle. booked the flight on company card but upgrade was on my personal cc. can i get reimbursed? receipt attached to my expense but want to confirm process
Elaine (People Ops): sorry to hear that, hope you’re okay. yes — we reimburse medically necessary or accessibility-related seat upgrades. we need a copy of the airline receipt showing the upgrade charge + either an airline accessibility confirmation email OR a medical note. if this was urgent and you don’t have a doc, an airline confirmation + brief self-attestation is acceptable. please tag it as "Accessibility upgrade" in Concur and select expense code TRV-MED.
Marco G.: i have the airline email that says they added special assistance and the upgraded seat line item. no doctor's note because it was same-day. is that fine? also FYI the upgrade was $85
Julie (Travel): @Marco G. that should be fine. upload the airline email and the upgrade receipt (PDF). we also need the itinerary with fare breakdown so we can verify it’s an add-on and not a change fee/refund. for upgrades > $200 we require manager signoff, but $85 is straightforward.
people-ops-bot: Expense request A-3842 created for Marco G. — please upload docs to Concur under category "Accessibility upgrade". If you need a faster turnaround, reply with "pay-me-now" and @Elaine will advise.
Elaine (People Ops): :thumbsup: once you upload, we’ll route to travel ops to validate and then reimburse via payroll or direct card reimbursement (you can request direct reimbursement if you prefer). send me a DM if you want it expedited.
Marco G.: uploading now. thanks everyone!
Julie (Travel): quick note for the team — if airline provides a disability form (pdf) include that, it speeds approval. also flag any frequent flyer credits separately (they're not reimbursable).
Elaine (People Ops): noted. filing guidance: 1) attach airline upgrade receipt 2) attach airline accessibility confirmation or pdf 3) short attestation: "I required aisle seat due to temporary mobility limitation on [date]" 4) manager approval if >$200 5) select TRV-MED. happy to help if anything missing.
